title: The stories we carry beyond the classroom
category: Feature
deck: Between the first bell and the last light, a different kind of education unfolds. A look at the little moments that make a community.
date: 2026-11-04
image: /media/campus.jpg

A school is more than a collection of classrooms. It is the conversation that continues after the bell, the idea scribbled in a notebook, and the familiar face on the walk back from dinner.

What do we notice when we stop counting the hours and start paying attention to the people around us?
